svg.text: 4 side-view walker scenes and 6 top-down UAV scenes: the hazard each shows, the run it replays, and what happens against what should happen. Walker
outcomes are re-run here from the plant model; UAV outcomes come from the committed SITL runs.
Slow supply leak on a slope: balance lost before the hold engages
Protective stop removes leg force instead of crouching
Frozen posture feedback with no staleness monitor
Burst supply loss with failed load holding: cockpit drops
GCS link lost during observation, return-to-launch configured

g.text: Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · EC-nnn = edge case found by a failure search · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · FLT-nnn = walker fault in

sim/faults.yaml · GCS = ground control station · GPS = Global Positioning System · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software

candidate for SUS-A1 · SC-nnn = 2D walker scene (sim/figures) · SF-nnn = walker failure-search family (sim/search) · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SU-nnn = UAV PX4 SITL scenario · SUS-A1 = dockable
observation UAV · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
